messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Sometimes it is not safe to use certain medicines at the same time. Some drugs can affect your blood levels of other drugs you use, which may increase side effects or make the medicines less effective.
Other drugs may interact with amlodipine, including prescription and over-the-counter medicines, vitamins, and herbal products. Tell your doctor about all other medicines you use.
Tell your doctor if you take simvastatin. You should not take more than 20 mg of simvastatin daily while taking amlodipine.
Triplet: ["amlodipine", "requires patient disclosure", "all other medicines"]

The relation 'requires patient disclosure' in the triplet is defined as 'Patients using the subject drug must inform their healthcare provider about all other medications they are taking.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'requires patient to inform providers of': The patient taking the subject drug must disclose the specified medications to their healthcare providers.
B. 'requires monitoring of': Patients taking the subject drug may need the medical test or monitoring specified by the object entity.
C. 'has reporting option': Patients are encouraged to report side effects of the subject drug through the specified channel or method.
D. 'requires decision with': A decision regarding the use of the subject drug or the feeding method should be made jointly with a healthcare provider.
E. 'should not be used for': The subject drug is contraindicated for the specified medical condition or clinical scenario.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
